title: Northstar - migration risk workshop
source: Fictional Northstar workshop record and supplied chronology
scope: B1 cutover commitment - relationship integrity and recoverability
state: proposed response record; no numeric assessment or accepted ownership
decision_boundary: Whether current evidence supports committing to the 21 November B1 cutover

scale.likelihood_basis: No assessed probabilities or agreed likelihood scale were supplied
scale.impact_basis: Objective consequences are described directly without an invented ordinal placement
scale.score_warning: No score is calculated; distinct evidence mechanisms remain separate
scale.tolerance_source: Northstar B1 decision boundary in migration.md

risks.title: Attachment relationships may be incorrect
risks.cause: Inconsistent identifiers may break attachment-to-ticket mapping
risks.event: Migrated attachments link to the wrong ticket or lose their relationship
risks.effect: Accepted records are not usable despite apparently complete counts
risks.existing_control: Supplier mapping work and count reconciliation
risks.evidence: Population-wide linkage result and justified coverage strategy are not supplied
risks.preventive_response: Perform representative relationship checks with a justified coverage strategy and Saira review
risks.owner: Chen with Beck; capacity and acceptance to confirm
risks.trigger: Reproduced relationship errors, missing test inputs or no viable review window
risks.contingency: Open a linked issue, correct the mapping and retest affected relationships before decision
risks.note: This is not an observed failure at the 23 October cutoff.

risks.title: Restore may not produce a usable service
risks.cause: The actual restore scenario and environment have not been demonstrated
risks.event: Cutover failure cannot be recovered within the usable-service boundary
risks.effect: Support lacks a usable service and business disruption continues
risks.evidence: No applicable restore demonstration is supplied at the workshop cutoff
risks.preventive_response: Define the restore scenario and environment, execute it and obtain the required review
risks.owner: Technical performer to confirm; Rosa supplies service requirements
risks.trigger: Restore fails, test inputs are unavailable or review capacity disappears
risks.contingency: Keep hold or replan available, correct and retest before requesting go
risks.note: Supplier obligation does not remove residual business exposure.

events.label: Workshop cutoff
events.state: Both records are hypotheses; no later issue or failed restore is known

events.label: M-I002 records lost links
events.state: Later observed issue links to M-R01 without rewriting its earlier status

events.label: Restore demonstration fails
events.state: Later gate failure updates recovery evidence in a later snapshot

presentation.headline: Separate relationship integrity from recovery
presentation.lede: Two distinct failure mechanisms need distinct evidence, owners, triggers and decisions.
presentation.decision: Obtain relationship checks and a separate restore demonstration before commitment; keep hold or replan available if required proof is absent.

analysis.method: Independent premortem input is consolidated into cause-event-effect records and challenged with present evidence before response selection.
analysis.scoring_boundary: No agreed matrix or assessed values were supplied; both risks stay in the unknown lane and later incidents do not create backdated probabilities.
analysis.authority_boundary: The workshop proposes Chen, Beck and Rosa roles but does not confirm capacity, transfer business exposure or issue Noel's cutover decision.
analysis.review_rule: Revisit on relationship findings, restore results, accepted owners, material scope change or loss of a viable review window.
